_readme: Edit these from the Criteria tab on the website. Each criteria set is a full list of thresholds. The schedule says which set is in use from which date; each day is checked with the set in use on that day.

Hot season.description: Example: less wind needed when temperatures are high. Adjust before using.

typical_peak_max_f._note: Optional. Typical peak fire season max temperature (F) for a PSA, used by Burn Environment. PSAs not listed are estimated from each station's elevation.

lightning._note: Lightning is confirmed by hand in data/lightning.csv. This value only sets which stations are shown as 'dry enough' for context.

afternoon_hours._note: Local (Mountain) hours used for max temp / min RH. Wind is checked over the whole day.
